t2.title: Physical activity important for teenagers
t2.prompt: A youth magazine is accepting articles from readers. The topic is: "Why is physical activity important for teenagers?" Write your article, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Stay Active, Stay Healthy: Why Teens Need Exercise

In an era dominated by screens and sedentary lifestyles, physical activity has become more important than ever for teenagers. Yet many young people fail to get adequate exercise.

Firstly, regular exercise is essential for physical health. It helps maintain a healthy weight, strengthens bones and muscles, and reduces the risk of chronic diseases. Active teenagers are more likely to become healthy adults.

Moreover, physical activity has significant mental benefits. Exercise releases endorphins, which can reduce stress, anxiety, and symptoms of depression. For teenagers facing academic pressure, sports can provide a much-needed mental break.

Additionally, team sports teach valuable life skills such as teamwork, leadership, and discipline. These skills carry over into academic and professional life.

Ultimately, physical activity should be viewed as an investment in one's future. Whether through organized sports, gym workouts, or simply walking, teenagers should strive to stay active for a healthier, happier life.

t2.sampleB1:
Why Teenagers Need to Do More Exercise

It's important for teenagers to be active. Many teenagers like to play video games or watch TV, but this isn't very good for them. In my opinion, physical activity is very important for a few reasons.

Firstly, exercise helps you stay healthy. If you play sports, you are less likely to get sick. Also, it helps you keep a healthy weight. For example, I play football twice a week and I feel much better than when I just stayed at home.

Secondly, exercise is good for your mind. When you exercise, your body releases chemicals that make you feel happy. I think this is very important because teenagers can get stressed about school. Therefore, exercise can help them relax. In conclusion, teenagers should try to do more exercise for their health and happiness.
t2.sampleB2:
Move More, Feel Better: Why Exercise Matters for Teens

Let's be honest — after a long day at school, flopping onto the sofa with a phone feels far easier than heading out for a run. But physical activity is one of the best things teenagers can do for themselves, and here's why.

Firstly, exercise keeps our bodies strong. Regular sport helps us stay in shape, builds healthy bones and muscles, and lowers the risk of chronic diseases later in life. Simply working out a few times a week boosts your energy, so you feel more awake in class.

On top of that, being active does wonders for the mind. Sport releases endorphins that lift our mood and help us cope with the pressure of exams. Honestly, a quick game with friends can turn a bad day around.

It also brings people together. Team sports teach skills that carry over into everyday life, such as teamwork, patience and discipline.

So why not give it a go? Whether it's football, dancing or a quick jog around the block, staying active is an investment that will pay off for years to come.
t2.uzSample:
Faol bo'ling, sog'lom bo'ling: Nima uchun o'smirlarga jismoniy mashqlar kerak

Ekranlar va harakatsiz turmush tarzi hukmron bo'lgan davrda, jismoniy faollik o'smirlar uchun har qachongidan ham muhimroq bo'lib qoldi. Ammo ko'plab yoshlar yetarli darajada jismoniy mashq qilmaydilar.

Birinchidan, muntazam jismoniy mashqlar jismoniy salomatlik uchun zarurdir. U sog'lom vaznni saqlashga, suyaklar va mushaklarni mustahkamlashga va surunkali kasalliklar xavfini kamaytirishga yordam beradi. Faol o'smirlar sog'lom kattalar bo'lish ehtimoli ko'proq.

Bundan tashqari, jismoniy faollikning sezilarli ruhiy foydalari bor. Jismoniy mashqlar endorfinlarni chiqaradi, bu stress, tashvish va depressiya alomatlarini kamaytirishi mumkin. Akademik bosimga duch kelayotgan o'smirlar uchun sport juda zarur bo'lgan ruhiy tanaffusni ta'minlashi mumkin.

Qolaversa, jamoaviy sport turlari jamoada ishlash, yetakchilik va intizom kabi qimmatli hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatadi. Bu ko'nikmalar akademik va professional hayotga ham o'tadi.

Nihoyat, jismoniy faollikni o'z kelajagiga sarmoya sifatida ko'rish kerak. Tashkillashtirilgan sport, sport zalidagi mashg'ulotlar yoki oddiygina piyoda yurish orqali bo'lsin, o'smirlar sog'lomroq va baxtliroq hayot uchun faol bo'lishga intilishlari kerak.

Men sportni yaxshi ko'raman. Sport yaxshi. Men futbol o'ynayman. Bu qiziqarli. Men o'ynaganimda xursand bo'laman.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:

Menimcha, sport o'smirlar uchun foydali. Men futbol va basketbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Bu qiziqarli va men do'stlarim bilan o'ynashim mumkin. Bu mening tanam uchun ham yaxshi, chunki men ko'p yuguraman. Men butun kun o'tirib televizor ko'rishni yoqtirmayman, chunki bu zerikarli. Sport yaxshiroq, chunki siz yangi odamlar bilan tanishishingiz va baxtli bo'lishingiz mumkin. Sport muhim, chunki u sizni sog'lom va baxtli qiladi.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Nega o'smirlar ko'proq jismoniy mashqlar qilishi kerak?

O'smirlarning faol bo'lishi muhim. Ko'p o'smirlar video o'yinlar o'ynashni yoki televizor ko'rishni yoqtirishadi, lekin bu ular uchun unchalik yaxshi emas. Mening fikrimcha, jismoniy faollik bir necha sabablarga ko'ra juda muhim.

Birinchidan, mashq qilish sog'lom bo'lishga yordam beradi. Agar siz sport bilan shug'ullansangiz, kasal bo'lish ehtimoli kamroq bo'ladi. Shuningdek, u sog'lom vaznni saqlashga yordam beradi. Misol uchun, men haftada ikki marta futbol o'ynayman va uyda o'tirganimga qaraganda o'zimni ancha yaxshi his qilaman.

Ikkinchidan, mashq qilish aql uchun ham foydali. Mashq qilganingizda, tanangiz sizni baxtli his qiladigan kimyoviy moddalarni chiqaradi. O'smirlar maktab haqida stressga tushishlari mumkinligi sababli, bu juda muhim deb o'ylayman. Shuning uchun, mashq qilish ularga dam olishga yordam beradi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, o'smirlar sog'lig'i va baxti uchun ko'proq mashq qilishga harakat qilishlari kerak.
t2.uzSampleB2:
O‘smirlar uchun jismoniy faollikning ahamiyati

Bugungi kunda, texnologiya bizning vaqtimizning katta qismini egallagan bir paytda, o‘smirlarning harakatsiz bo‘lib qolishi oson. Biroq, muntazam jismoniy faoliyat bilan shug‘ullanish yoshlarning farovonligi uchun juda muhimdir. Jismoniy mashqlar o‘smirning hayotining muhim qismiga aylanishiga sabab bo‘ladigan ko‘plab foydali jihatlar mavjud, bular jismoniy va ruhiy foydalardir.

Birinchidan, jismoniy faollik umumiy salomatlikka sezilarli hissa qo‘shadi. Muntazam mashqlar sog‘lom vaznni saqlashga, yurak-qon tomir tizimini mustahkamlashga va hayotning keyingi davrida diabet va yurak kasalliklari kabi surunkali kasalliklarning rivojlanish xavfini kamaytirishga yordam beradi. Bundan tashqari, u suyak zichligini va mushak kuchini yaxshilaydi, bu esa uzoq muddatli jismoniy salomatlik uchun zarurdir.

Jismoniy foydalardan tashqari, mashqlar ruhiy farovonlikda muhim rol o‘ynaydi. U stress, tashvish va depressiya alomatlarini kamaytirishi isbotlangan. Jamoaviy sport turlari yoki individual mashg‘ulotlarda ishtirok etish o‘z-o‘zini qadrlash va ishonchni oshirishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, sport orqali o‘rganilgan intizom va jamoaviy ish akademik va kelajakdagi karera kabi hayotning boshqa sohalarida ham qimmatli aktiv bo‘lishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, jismoniy faollik faqatgina sport formani saqlash haqida emas; bu sog‘lom va mazmunli o‘smirlik hayotining muhim tarkibiy qismidir. Yoshlarni sport, raqs yoki har qanday jismoniy faoliyat bilan shug‘ullanishga undash ularning kelajakdagi jismoniy va ruhiy salomatligiga sarmoyadir.

t12.title: formal letter · to committee
t12.prompt: Write a formal letter to the Town Planning Committee with your suggestions for the sports center. Explain why your suggested facilities would benefit young people.
t12.sample:
Dear Planning Committee,

I am writing to share my suggestions for the proposed youth sports center. As a teenager in this community, I believe I can offer valuable insight.

Firstly, a swimming pool would be an excellent addition. Swimming is a low-impact exercise suitable for all ages and fitness levels.

Additionally, I would recommend including indoor basketball courts. Basketball is extremely popular among young people and would attract many users throughout the year.

Furthermore, offering group fitness classes such as martial arts or dance could appeal to those who prefer structured activities.

These facilities would promote healthy lifestyles and provide young people with positive outlets for their energy.

Yours sincerely,
A Local Teenager

Bye

I am writing to you about the new sports center. I think it is a good idea. I think the sports center should have a swimming pool because swimming is good exercise. Also, it should have basketball courts because lots of young people like to play basketball. For example, my friends and I play basketball every weekend. I also think it would be good to have a gym with weights. This is because young people need to be strong and healthy. However, it is important to make sure the gym is safe.

t12.sampleB2:
Dear Town Planning Committee,

I am writing in response to your letter regarding the proposed youth sports centre, and I would like to put forward a few suggestions.

Firstly, I strongly recommend including a swimming pool. Swimming is a low-impact exercise that suits all fitness levels and gives young people a safe way to keep fit all year round.

Secondly, indoor basketball courts would prove hugely popular. They encourage teamwork and would attract players whatever the weather. This means the centre stays busy even during the long winter months.

Finally, a range of fitness classes would appeal to teenagers who prefer structured activities to traditional sport. Together, these facilities would promote healthy lifestyles and give young people a positive place to spend their free time.

Yours faithfully,
Bekzod Aliyev
